Container.Name: Gamendar
Container.Overview: Self-hosted team availability scheduler. Users log in and mark which days they are available for each weekly event; admins manage users, create events and configure optional Discord and Signal notifications. Leave SECRET_KEY blank and a strong key is generated into the data volume on first start. Default login is admin / admin123 - change it immediately.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank and a strong key is generated into the data volume on first start. Set one only if you want to manage it yourself.
